{{recipesummary|category=Soup recipes|servings=12|time=35 minutes|difficulty=3|image=[[File:A bowl of Zuppa Toscana prepared from the Wikibooks recipe.JPG|300px|A bowl of Zuppa Toscana.]]}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Soup|Soup]]

'''Zuppa toscana'''<!--Not a typo; Italian does not capitalize adjectives derived from proper names.--> is a soup available at the Olive Garden restaurant.

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] spicy Italian [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]], crumbled
*½ lb smoked [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Quart|qt]] water
*2 cans (29 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
*2 large russet [[Cookbook:Potato|potato]]es, cubed
*2 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] cloves, crushed
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], chopped
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] chopped [[Cookbook:Kale|kale]] or Swiss [[Cookbook:Chard|chard]]
*1 cup heavy [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
#In a [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium-high heat, brown the sausage, breaking into small pieces as you [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] it. Drain and set aside.
#In skillet over medium-high heat, brown bacon. Drain and set aside.
#Place water, broth, potatoes, garlic, and onion into a pot. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] over high heat until potatoes are tender.
#Add sausage and bacon to the pot. Simmer for 10 minutes.
#Add kale/chard and cream to the pot. Seasons with salt and pepper; heat through.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Potatoes can be substituted with [[Cookbook:Cauliflower|cauliflower]] for a low-carbohydrate version of this soup.
* You can also use half mild half spicy turkey sausage instead of pork sausage.
* Sometimes, [[Cookbook:Fennel|fennel]] is used.
